content:
For a trigonometric function
\[
f(x)=A\sin(\omega x+\phi)+D,
\]
the period is
\[
T=\frac{2\pi}{|\omega|}.
\]

From the graph, consecutive maxima occur near \(x=-5.50\) and \(x=-2.36\). Their horizontal separation is
\[
T\approx -2.36-(-5.50)=3.14=\pi.
\]
This corresponds to the integer angular frequency \(\omega=2\), since \(2\pi/2=\pi\).

\[
\boxed{\pi}
\]
